# Twitter / X — 2011

Brooklyn life plus Hitchens dying, WoW hitting cap, Colbert Report check-in, Chris Dodd, and the first '1984 = 2012' political reflex. Still a live-scrape year; the December cluster is dense and the rest of the calendar is not yet on the page.

## Gaps

The operator spreadsheet begins 2013-08-17. 2011 is being walked from live X search in batches of ten; this page currently holds 225 originals and will be appended as further batches land. Do not treat the present count as the year's total.

This page is the text archive. Every original and every quote-tweet with Dan's own text that has been retrieved for the year is below, oldest first. Pure reposts with no @danfrank quote content are omitted.
